[[Chung, the Attuned]] is an [[Am Fah]] [[boss]] who can be found in [[the Undercity]].  He can also appear in the [[Bukdek Byway]] [[explorable area]] if the [[quest]] [[Eliminate the Am Fah]] is active.

== Locations ==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|Bukdek Byway}} (only during the quest [[Eliminate the Am Fah]]) 
** {{NPC location|The Undercity}} (except during parts of [[Chasing Zenmai]])

== Quests ==
'''Quests involved in:'''
* [[Chung, the Attuned (Zaishen quest)]]
* [[Eliminate the Am Fah]]

== Skills ==
19 [[Air Magic]]
* {{skill icon|Aura of Restoration}}
* {{skill icon|Elemental Attunement}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Lightning Hammer}}
* {{skill icon|Lightning Orb}}
* {{skill icon|Shock Arrow}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Chung's Focus]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==

* Chung and two groups of Am Fah [[popup|ambush]] the party as a player character approaches the [[spawn]]ing location marked on the map. 
* Chung's damage output is unusually high.
